questions.prompt: A block of mass $4\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a rough horizontal floor by a force of magnitude $20\text{ N}$ acting at an angle of $30^\circ$ above the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the block and the floor is $0.25$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction exerted by the floor on the block, and calculate the acceleration of the block.

questions.prompt: A small bead of mass $0.2\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a smooth horizontal wire. A constant force of $0.8\text{ N}$ acts on the bead at an angle of $60^\circ$ to the wire.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the bead along the wire, and determine the vertical force exerted by the wire on the bead.

questions.prompt: A ring of mass $0.5\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a rough horizontal rod. A tension force $T$ acts on the ring at an angle of $45^\circ$ above the rod. When the ring moves along the rod at a constant speed, the normal reaction between the rod and the ring is $2.0\text{ N}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the value of $T$, and find the coefficient of friction between the ring and the rod.

questions.prompt: A crate of mass $6\text{ kg}$ is pushed along rough horizontal ground by a force of $25\text{ N}$ directed downwards at an angle of $20^\circ$ below the horizontal. The coefficient of friction is $0.2$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the normal reaction is approximately $68.55\text{ N}$, and calculate the acceleration of the crate.

questions.prompt: A bead of mass $0.4\text{ kg}$ on a rough horizontal wire is pulled by a light string inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the wire, where $\cos\theta = 0.8$ and $\sin\theta = 0.6$. The tension in the string is $5\text{ N}$, and the bead moves with acceleration $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction exerted by the wire on the bead, and calculate the coefficient of friction.

questions.prompt: A ring of mass $0.25\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a smooth horizontal rod. Two forces act on the ring: a force of $3\text{ N}$ acting horizontally to the right along the rod, and a force of $4\text{ N}$ acting at an angle of $60^\circ$ above the rod to the left.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude and direction of the acceleration of the ring along the rod.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $5\text{ kg}$ is pulled along a rough horizontal plane by a constant tension force $T = 20\text{ N}$ acting at an angle of $25^\circ$ above the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the block and the plane is $0.3$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction exerted by the plane on the block.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the block.

questions.prompt: A ring of mass $0.6\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a rough horizontal rod. A pull of magnitude $P$ acts on the ring at an angle of $30^\circ$ above the rod. The coefficient of friction between the ring and the rod is $0.4$. The ring accelerates from rest along the rod.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Given that $P = 4\text{ N}$, show that the normal reaction is $4.0\text{ N}$, and find the acceleration of the ring.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the distance travelled by the ring from rest in the first $3\text{ s}$, and find the speed it attains.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $8\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal table. A pulling force of magnitude $P$ acts on the block at an angle of $30^\circ$ above the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the block and the table is $0.25$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the value of $P$ for which the block is on the point of slipping.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: If the force is increased to $P = 30\text{ N}$, find the normal reaction and the acceleration of the block.

questions.prompt: A ring of mass $0.3\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a rough horizontal wire. A constant force of magnitude $10\text{ N}$ is applied to the ring at an angle $\theta$ above the wire. The coefficient of friction between the ring and the wire is $0.5$. The ring accelerates along the wire at $6.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Assuming the wire exerts an upward normal reaction on the ring, write down the vertical equilibrium equation and the horizontal equation of motion in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: If instead the force acts at an angle of $\theta = 20^\circ$ above the wire, show that the normal reaction is positive, and calculate the new acceleration of the ring.

questions.prompt: A small block of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is placed on a rough horizontal surface. Two forces act on the block: a pull $P_1 = 12\text{ N}$ at $30^\circ$ above the horizontal to the right, and a push $P_2 = 8\text{ N}$ at $45^\circ$ below the horizontal to the right. The coefficient of friction is $0.2$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the normal reaction exerted by the surface on the block is approximately $19.66\text{ N}$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the block.

questions.prompt: A bead of mass $0.5\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a rough horizontal wire. A force $P$ acts on the bead at an angle of $30^\circ$ above the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between the bead and the wire is $0.6$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the value of $P$ for which the bead is on the point of moving to the right, assuming the wire exerts an upward reaction on the bead.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the critical value of $P$ at which the contact force between the bead and the wire becomes zero.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: If $P = 14\text{ N}$, determine the direction and magnitude of the normal reaction exerted by the wire on the bead, and calculate the acceleration of the bead along the wire.

questions.prompt: A ring of mass $0.4\text{ kg}$ is threaded on a rough horizontal wire. Forces of $8\text{ N}$ and $5\text{ N}$ act on the ring: the $8\text{ N}$ force acts horizontally along the wire to the right, and the $5\text{ N}$ force acts at an angle of $40^\circ$ above the wire to the left. The ring starts from rest and travels $1.8\text{ m}$ in $2.0\text{ s}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the ring along the wire.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the normal reaction exerted by the wire on the ring.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Calculate the coefficient of friction between the ring and the wire.
